title: Supply Chain Operations Analytics
problem_statement: An operations leader needs to prioritize the product-region combinations responsible for late delivery, long cycle time, and modeled margin exposure.
questions: Where are delays and profit concentrated?
Which groups show unstable cycle time?
What process areas deserve root-cause analysis?
hypotheses: Cycle time is associated with late delivery.
Profit and service risk concentrate in different groups.
recommendations: Use a Pareto review that combines service risk and economic impact.
Validate carrier, facility, and inventory causes before changing SLAs.
